summary: Final methodological research feedback at the run's budget boundary (action=research), leaving the map and the confirmed findings untouched. It records why the one unsettled lead - an Apply/ApplyLog future that can be abandoned at shutdown when BatchApplyCh buffers the channel - has no admissible confirming check in this framework: the mechanism is read (a logFuture carries no shutdown channel, so Error() selects only on its response channel; Shutdown closes shutdownCh without draining applyCh, so an accepted future is never answered), but the only observable would be non-return within a finite window, which per the review criteria records non-completion rather than a deadline violation or indefinite stalling, and making the pending state deterministic would require omitting the running loop whose behaviour is in question, while starting the loop would race its own receipt of the future. The feedback keeps the lead as a deferred surface needing either a caller-visible contract fixing the required outcome or an observation mechanism that distinguishes a lost future from a slow one, and restates the remaining frontier (Restore reporting surface, FSM manager's snapshot/persist side, tcp transport stream/pooling, TimeoutNow-without-term and ordering-intent questions, and the constructed-environment limits on the eight confirmed checks). Run outcome: six confirmed_in_scope conclusions across eight implementation_reproduced findings, a fully mapped surface set plus two deferred surfaces, and a coherent accepted map at version 14. Preflight returned valid:true with roughly 630 seconds of budget remaining.
